questions.question: What is HOL Archive?
questions.answer: HOL Archive is a premium hospitality, operations, and logistics company specialising in luxury event execution. We handle every detail — from guest experience design and vendor coordination to on-ground logistics — ensuring your event is flawlessly delivered and permanently archived as a timeless memory.

questions.question: Why is it called Archive?
questions.answer: Archive reflects our philosophy that every event we create should be worthy of permanent preservation. We don't just execute events — we curate experiences so meticulously crafted that they become timeless records. Each project is added to our archive as a testament to precision and luxury.

questions.question: Do you manage luxury events?
questions.answer: Yes, we manage luxury weddings, destination celebrations, corporate galas, brand activations, private milestones, and large-scale productions. Our operational frameworks scale to match from 50 to 1,000+ guests.

questions.question: Do you handle custom installations?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We coordinate directly with art directors, production designers, and structural engineers to ensure custom builds and scenography are constructed safely and to exact aesthetic standards.

questions.question: How do you coordinate with international partners?
questions.answer: We establish unified communication systems, joint timelines, and check-in protocols to integrate international partners seamlessly into the local delivery timeline.

title: What types of events do you manage?

questions.question: Do you manage destination weddings?
questions.answer: Yes. We coordinate destination weddings globally, managing travel logistics, local vendor vetting, hospitality suites, guest routing, and on-site event execution.

questions.question: Do you manage corporate summits?
questions.answer: Yes. We design and coordinate corporate galas, high-profile summits, product launches, and brand activations with detailed logistics frameworks.

questions.question: Do you manage private celebrations?
questions.answer: Yes. Private celebrations including milestones, intimate anniversaries, and VIP dining experiences are curated with the same attention to detail.

questions.question: What is the scale limit for events you manage?
questions.answer: We manage events ranging from intimate 30-guest dinners to large-scale productions with 1,000+ delegates. Our systems are fully scale-invariant.

questions.question: Do support virtual or hybrid events?
questions.answer: Yes. We establish dedicated broadcast lines, stage monitoring, and virtual audience integration to ensure high-fidelity hybrid delivery.

questions.question: Can you manage events in remote locations?
questions.answer: Yes, we specialize in high-complexity logistics for remote locations, setting up temporary power, water, communication arrays, and supply chains.

questions.question: How do you handle security for VIP attendees?
questions.answer: We coordinate directly with local authorities and private security details to design secure transit lanes, entrance checks, and private holding zones.

questions.question: Do you handle hospitality for guest travel?
questions.answer: Yes. We manage flight bookings, local transfers, hotel check-ins, custom welcome hampers, and hospitality helpdesks throughout the stay.

title: Which cities and countries do you operate in?

questions.question: What is your primary operating region?
questions.answer: Our primary base is Mumbai, India, with active operations across Delhi, Jaipur, Dubai, Singapore, and London.

questions.question: Are you able to mobilize internationally?
questions.answer: Yes. We are equipped to mobilize teams globally for destination weddings, international summits, and cross-border brand activations.

questions.question: Do you charge extra for travel outside Mumbai?
questions.answer: Our management fees remain stable. Travel, logistics, and accommodation for the core team are billed as project actuals in the budget.

questions.question: How do you manage local vendor relations in new cities?
questions.answer: We leverage our global partner database and conduct rigorous on-ground vetting audits to ensure all local vendors meet our quality benchmarks.

title: How far in advance should I reach out?

questions.question: What is the recommended lead time for weddings?
questions.answer: For destination weddings and luxury celebrations, we recommend initiating contact at least 6–12 months in advance.

questions.question: What is the lead time for corporate events?
questions.answer: For corporate summits, product launches, or brand activations, 2–3 months is typically sufficient.

questions.question: Do you accept last-minute bookings?
questions.answer: Yes, we assess last-minute bookings based on current scheduling and team availability. Reach out via our contact form to confirm feasibility.

questions.question: What is the first step in the onboarding process?
questions.answer: The first step is a consultation call where we discuss your event vision, scope, spatial requirements, and general timelines.

questions.question: How long does it take to receive a proposal?
questions.answer: After our initial consultation, we typically deliver a customized operational scope and fee proposal within 3-5 business days.

questions.question: Can I hold dates before signing a contract?
questions.answer: Dates are formally reserved only upon contract execution and receipt of the initial onboarding deposit.
